subject: Mapping and triage: consultant-integrator pipeline split for Horizon Labs
messages:
From: Evan Brooks <evan@horizon-labs.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick — who owns Horizon Labs (consultant vs integrator)?

Hi Karthik / Marissa,

We ran the pilot with Sage Integrations last quarter and their team suggested bringing in BlueWave Consulting for implementation. Legal just asked why we have two partners in the same account — they want a clear engagement lead for procurement and SLAs. Who currently owns the partner lead in your systems? Evan (Horizon) is asking for a single point of contact so they can route purchase orders.

Evan Brooks
Head of Platform Partnerships | Horizon Labs

---
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Brooks <evan@horizon-labs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick — who owns Horizon Labs (consultant vs integrator)?

Thanks for the note, Evan — and for flagging the PO/legal ask. Short answer: both partners are active in the pipeline, but we don't have a clear territory split documented for Horizon. I'm looping in Marissa and Monica to align on an immediate triage and a more durable mapping.

Proposed short-term:
- Redwood will assign a single partner lead for procurement coordination (we can put Sage as primary for ongoing integrations and BlueWave as implementation/enablement under a sub-contract).
- We'll update HubSpot deal DL-2026-3891 to reflect the lead and add the partner SOWs to the record.

I'll run the mapping exercise and attach a draft MAP file for your review. Is next Tuesday morning OK for a 30-min call to confirm?

Thanks,
Karthik
Head of Partner Solutions | Redwood Inference

---
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Evan Brooks <evan@horizon-labs.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick — who owns Horizon Labs (consultant vs integrator)?

Evan — quick context: Sage brought the technical integration and holds the engineering relationship; BlueWave is an incumbent consultant that Horizon uses for change mgmt and custom connector work. Both parties can add value, but buyers prefer a single invoice and a clarified support path.

Action items I propose for this thread:
1) Short-term: Redwood assigns Sage as the commercial/invoice lead, BlueWave as implementation partner (subcontractor). That keeps Sage responsible for SLA + billing.
2) Mid-term: Formalize co-sell rules in the partner MAP (territory by product module: Core API vs Data Connectors).
3) Marissa to draft commercial language for a two-party engagement and circulate for legal redlines.

I've attached proposal_v2.pdf with suggested billing language and two routing options.

Marissa Cole
Director, Alliances | Redwood Inference
Attachment: proposal_v2.pdf (PDF)

---
From: Lila Grant <lila@bluewave.consulting>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Evan Brooks <evan@horizon-labs.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick — who owns Horizon Labs (consultant vs integrator)?

Appreciate the heads-up. BlueWave has a pending SOW with Horizon for connector customization (signed LOI). We expect to be the implementation lead — Sage's role was never fully formalized on our side. If Redwood assigns Sage as the billing lead without consulting our contract, that will cause friction.

I'm happy to jump on the call and present the existing SOW. I've attached BlueWave_SOW.docx.

Best,
Lila Grant
Director of Partnerships | BlueWave Consulting
Attachment: BlueWave_SOW.docx (DOCX)

---
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Evan Brooks <evan@horizon-labs.com>, Lila Grant <lila@bluewave.consulting>, Sage Integrations <sales@sageintegrations.io>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 11:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick — who owns Horizon Labs (consultant vs integrator)? — proposed triage

Folks — thanks for the quick replies. To close this cleanly I recommend the following triage (short timeline):
- Step 1 (by 10/22 EOD): Karthik/Marissa to complete a MAP row for Horizon in the shared Horizon-MAP-draft.xlsx and mark primary partner owner and fallback.
- Step 2 (by 10/25): Legal to confirm if BlueWave SOW requires approval for Sage-led billing (Marissa to route proposal_v2.pdf + BlueWave_SOW.docx).
- Step 3 (by 10/29): If contractual conflict exists, propose a split: Sage = Core API + integrations billing, BlueWave = custom connector delivery and O&M under a subcontracting fee.

I attached the draft MAP column headers in the spreadsheet. Karthik — can you please update the HubSpot deal with the initial assignment and include the MAP file link?

Jonas Weber
Alliances Operations Lead | Redwood Inference
Attachment: Horizon-MAP-draft.xlsx (XLSX)

---
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Brooks <evan@horizon-labs.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Lila Grant <lila@bluewave.consulting>, Sage Integrations <sales@sageintegrations.io>
Date: Fri, 22 Oct 2026 15:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick — who owns Horizon Labs (consultant vs integrator)? — plan & next steps

Team — summary & next steps after review:
1) Immediate assignment: Sage Integrations will be listed as the commercial/billing owner in HubSpot deal DL-2026-3891; BlueWave will be logged as the implementation partner with a linked SOW. (Status: updated)
2) Contracts: Marissa to send a short addendum template to BlueWave that clarifies sub-contracting relationship and invoicing flow. Target to have addendum signed by 10/29.
3) Technical ownership: Horizon confirmed Sage is primary for API integration; BlueWave will own custom connector delivery and first-line support for those modules.
4) Billing path: Single invoice option approved — Sage will bill Horizon and pass-through BlueWave line items per addendum.

Action owners:
- Marissa: circulate addendum + route to Legal (due 10/26).
- Karthik: confirm HubSpot deal updated and attach Horizon-MAP-draft.xlsx (done). HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/3891
- Monica: add routing rules to Partner Console to reflect primary/fallback (due 10/28).

Evan — please confirm if the above flow works on your end or if you want BlueWave to remain the commercial owner. If we don't hear back by Monday EOD we'll proceed with Sage as billing owner to avoid PO delays.

Thanks all — closing loop soon.
Karthik
Head of Partner Solutions | Redwood Inference
Attachment: Horizon-MAP-draft.xlsx (XLSX)
